import xarray as xr
import icechunk
. In this case we will analyze Calgary Hail Storm event. However, you can change it to Ontario Derecho by uncommenting the other prefix lines

storage = icechunk.s3_storage(
    bucket='pythia',
    prefix='radar/ams2025/CASSM.zarr', # Calgary Hail Storm
    # prefix='radar/ams2025/CASET.zarr', # CASET Ontario Derecho
    # prefix='radar/ams2025/CASKR.zarr', # CASKR Ontario Derecho

    endpoint_url='https://js2.jetstream-cloud.org:8001',
    anonymous=True,
    region='us-east-1',
    force_path_style=True
)
